shellCommands.command: git status --short && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -80 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -200

cat src/App.tsx && echo ---- && cat src/main.tsx && echo ---- && cat index.html && echo ---- && cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && echo ---- && cat AGENTS.md && echo ---- && grep -n -i -A12 'date\|calendar' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar DatePicker 2>&1 | head -80; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20

npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -40; for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[]," ' | grep -E '^[0-9]' | tail -12); do echo "$v: $(npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n ')"; done; echo; npm view @gravity-ui/date-utils version peerDependencies 2>/dev/null

npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@^4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn Unknown' | tail -15; grep -E '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/ | head -30

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components; echo ----; grep -n -i -A25 'required setup\|## Setup\|ThemeProvider\|styles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md | head -60

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components/Calendar.md; echo ----; grep -rn "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist | head -30

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist; grep -rln "CalendarProps" $D --include=*.d.ts | head; F=$(grep -rl "export.*CalendarProps\|interface CalendarProps\|type CalendarProps" $D --include=*.d.ts | head -1); echo "FILE $F"; grep -n "onUpdate\|value?\|defaultValue\|timeZone\|size?" $F | head -20; echo ----; DU=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils; ls $DU/dist | head; grep -rn "format(\|toDate\|export declare function dateTime\b\|export declare const dateTime\|dateTime(" $DU/dist/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls $DU/dist/docs 2>/dev/null

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; cat $D; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ----; grep -n '"main"\|"types"\|"exports"' -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json | head -20; echo ----; DU=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils; ls $DU; grep -n '"types"\|"main"' $DU/package.json

grep -n "onUpdate\|value?\|defaultValue" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts | head; grep -n "CalendarValueType" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts | head -12; echo ----; D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build; ls $D | head -30; grep -rn "format(\|toDate(\|export.*dateTime\b" $D/index.d.ts | head; grep -rln "interface DateTime\|type DateTime" $D --include=*.d.ts | head -3

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build; grep -n "format\|toDate\|valueOf\|export interface DateTime\|export type DateTime" $D/typings/dateTime.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; grep -n "onUpdate\|CalendarStateOptions" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; ls $D/docs 2>/dev/null; grep -n "format" $D/docs/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rn "dateTime\|format" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/README.md | head -10

grep -rn "interface ValueBase" -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types/*.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; grep -rn "CalendarStateOptionsBase" -A8 node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts | head -20; echo ----; grep -n "FORMAT\|format" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/README.md | head -3; grep -n "export.*dateTimeParse" -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/**/*.d.ts | head -3

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -120; echo ----; grep -n "variant" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -80 | tr '\n' ' '

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Flex Text 2>&1 | head -30; echo ----; grep -n "direction\|gap" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "DateTime\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/index.d.ts | head -3
npx tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit=$?"; cat .gitignore; echo ----; git diff --stat; grep -n "gravity-ui\|date-utils" package.json
